Class TurnOrderSlot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.turnorder.TurnOrderSlot
public class TurnOrderSlot extends Object
One of the slots of the turn order tile. Each slot has an index, a food delta (positive = reward, negative = cost) and may host one player at a time.

    • TurnOrderSlot

      public TurnOrderSlot(int index, int foodDelta, String playerIdInSlot)
      Builds a new turn order slot.
      Parameters:
      index - 0-based position on the turn order tile
      foodDelta - food delta produced when a player lands on the slot
      playerIdInSlot - id of the player initially placed on the slot, or null
